programme.desc: Mass accommodation sites are central to the government's plan to end the use of asylum hotels. This undercover investigation goes inside Crowborough, a former military training camp now housing asylum seekers. programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Tommy and his plucky pals go on a forest adventure in his father's latest invention, the Reptar Wagon.

programme.desc: The children and their bickering family are stranded on a desert island. Fortunately help is at hand from the Thornberry family, who are visiting the island to film a rare snow leopard. Once again, animal-understanding Eliza saves the day.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

programme.title: The BFG
programme.desc: A 10-year-old girl, Queen Elizabeth II and the Big Friendly Giant must devise a plan to get rid of Bloodbottler, Fleshlumpeater and all the other bad giants once and for all.

When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Mavis surprises Dracula with plans for a fun-filled summer voyage on a monster cruise. As the pack starts enjoying colossal buffets and exotic excursions, Drac finds himself falling for the ship's intriguing but dangerous captain. He soon learns that trying to balance family, friends and romance might just be too much to handle. Even for the world's most powerful vampire.

Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world.

However, when his rival, Hansel, unexpectedly takes the crown, Derek is crushed. He becomes easy prey for fashion designer Jacobim Mugatu, who signs Derek to star in his 'Derelicte' fashion show, then brainwashes him to kill Malaysia's prime minister.

programme.title: Zoolander 2

programme.desc: A rivalry comes about between two best friends when they each schedule their respective weddings on the same day.

programme.title: Sixteen Candles

programme.desc: A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished. Trying to help some teenagers, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now David's in big debt to his supplier, and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: he packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Two police officers begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.

programme.title: Bridesmaids
programme.desc: Asked to be maid of honour, the best friend of a bride must suddenly face off with an alpha bridesmaid, a woman who clearly wants to take over her job and her best friend status.

programme.desc: An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls
programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: A group of good-hearted but incompetent misfits enter the police academy, but the instructors there are not going to put up with their pranks.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: Mahoney and friends have graduated from the Police Academy and are issued with their first assignments. As before, their cheerfulness and devotion to duty outweighs any shortcomings, but are they ready to do battle with a band of graffiti daubing terrorists?

programme.desc: Slapstick farce with the incompetent cops as they set about saving their beloved academy from closure. Cutbacks mean that only one of the two police training schools can stay open, so Commandant Lassard appeals to the motley crew of graduates to come and train new recruits. However, the rival academy intends to sabotage their plans by cutting their training time down to a minimum.

programme.desc: A gung-ho, 'Thunderbirds'-style squad of puppets leads America's war on terrorism. The creators of 'South Park' go on the offensive with an outrageous animated satire that makes a target of everyone from politicians to Hollywood liberals.

Now, Pete and Ellie must try to learn the ropes of instant parenthood in the hope of becoming a family.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Agent Aaron Cross must use his genetically-enhanced skills to finish what Jason Bourne started in this action-packed hit that takes the Bourne series to explosive new levels.

Lee suspects that former operative Nicky Parsons is also looking for him. As she begins tracking the duo, Bourne finds himself back in action battling a sinister network that utilizes terror and technology to maintain unchecked power.

programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

programme.title: Jaws 2

Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Detroit

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: After an ambitious manager gives them a shot at stardom, three singers learn that fame can carry a high personal cost.

An employee of FedEx snatches a few days between flights with his loving family and fiancée, to whom he proposes, before rushing off on his next assignment. However, his plane crashes during a storm and over the next four years he must train himself to survive away from civilisation.

Sentenced to a year in prison for manslaughter, William begins serving his term, but before it's finished he decides to break out. With the help of his faithful and politically radical girlfriend, Jane (Barbara Hershey), he skips town and escapes to Canada, where the two are obliged to live like fugitives.

However, in her effort to succeed, she discovers that getting to the top is far from easy. Giorgio Moroder's composition 'Flashdance (What a Feeling)', sung by Irene Cara, won an Academy Award for Best Original Song.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Following a man's bid for survival on a desert island following a plane crash. An employee of FedEx snatches a few days between flights with his loving family and fiancée, to whom he proposes, before rushing off on his next assignment. However, his plane crashes during a storm and over the next four years he must train himself to survive away from civilisation.

Ignoring all advice, he befriends band members and groupies alike.

programme.desc: When his father's job results in a family move to the countryside, young German boy Bruno misses his old friends. Roaming the grounds of the large country house he now calls home, he discovers the huge fenced facility that his dad Ralf, a Nazi officer, now administers. Approaching it, Bruno meets Shmuel, a Jewish boy on the other side of the barbed wire, wearing what appears to be a pair of pyjamas.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievement in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Hull City's return to the Premier League is the latest chapter in a story built on resilience, ambition and belief. We look back on the club's previous adventures in the top-flight, reliving the moments that shaped its identity before looking ahead to an exciting new era. Joining the Tigers at their pre-season training camp in Slovenia, we go behind the scenes to discover how the club is preparing for the challenges ahead.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We follow Coventry City as they prepare for a long-awaited return to the Premier League, ending a 25-year absence from English football's top flight. With exclusive access during the club's pre-season training camp in Málaga, we go behind the scenes as players and staff build towards a landmark campaign filled with anticipation and expectation.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: One of the Premier League's greatest-ever goalkeepers, Petr Čech's career was nearly changed forever by the horrific head injury he suffered in 2006. We sit down with him to discuss his remarkable recovery and journey back to the very top, before discovering how his competitive drive has continued, with the Czech shot-stopper swapping football for a new challenge playing Ice Hockey.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From his early years in Ivory Coast to leaving Africa for Europe, Amad Diallo's journey has been one of talent, determination and sacrifice. After making his breakthrough in Italy, his potential earned him a dream move to Manchester United, where he has fought to establish himself on the Premier League stage. We follow Amad's remarkable rise and the journey that has taken him from humble beginnings to the heights of Old Trafford.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: John Stones has experienced almost everything the game can offer; from the pressure of the biggest stage to the injuries and setbacks that have tested him along the way. After more than a decade at the heart of the Premier League, winning its biggest honours and helping redefine the role of a modern defender, he now takes his career in a new direction.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From his family's courageous journey in search of a better future to becoming one of Europe's most respected midfielders, this is the story of Granit Xhaka. We chart his rise through the game, the highs and lows of a career that tested his resilience, and the turbulent relationship with Arsenal supporters that ultimately became one of football's greatest redemption stories.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: From a celebrated playing career in Italy to becoming the man who transformed Manchester City into Premier League champions, Roberto Mancini's footballing life has been filled with triumph, drama and unforgettable characters. PL Stories explores his fiery relationship with Mario Balotelli, 'that' extraordinary final-day victory over QPR, and the deep friendship he shared with the late Gianluca Vialli.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Once the last line of defence, today's goalkeeper is expected to be so much more. From sweeper-keepers to playing out under pressure, we explore the innovations, characters and changing demands that have revolutionised one of football's most fascinating positions.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Ipswich Town legend and former Sunderland striker Marcus Stewart built a career on taking on some of football's toughest challenges. Now, he faces a very different battle; one that has changed his life beyond the pitch and revealed a strength and determination far greater than anything football demanded of him.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: Aston Villa's 1992/93 season had all the ingredients of a defining football story. Through special behind-the-scenes footage, PL Stories takes viewers inside Ron Atkinson's Villa, revealing the characters, camaraderie and mounting pressure of a gripping title challenge. From the dressing room to the drama on the pitch, this is the inside story of Villa's pursuit of the first Premier League crown.

programme.title: Premier League Stories
programme.desc: We explore Mikel Arteta's impact at Arsenal and the managerial approach behind his success, reflecting on how his upbringing and football education in the Basque region shaped his thinking. We examine his tactics, how he develops players and the standards he sets throughout the club. We look at the key decisions that have turned Arsenal into Premier League champions.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.desc: As the days grow longer, the MacDonalds round up their pregnant Highland cattle on the tiny island of Vallay, off North Uist, for a prenatal check-up and vitamin boost. Meanwhile, Jenni's new alpaca arena is finally finished in Newtonmore.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for France
programme.desc: Eva charts the history of French cuisine via a seven-course fine dining meal aboard a Seine riverboat.

programme.title: Ireland with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon begins his journey in the south of Ireland, paramotoring with an Irish explorer. On the west coast he does a spot of surfing, before climbing Croagh Patrick in honour of Ireland's patron saint. This leg of his journey ends in Malin Head, Ireland's most northerly point.

programme.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob travel to the upper Tees, where Bob shares some very special childhood memories. They are joined by an old friend who tells them spooky tales about the river.

programme.title: A Course Called Ireland
programme.desc: With brother Joel bringing some Murray family rivalry, and Joanne McNally taking her first swing at golf, Bill's Irish adventure becomes a celebration of family, friends and what's next.

programme.title: Later ... with Jools Holland
programme.desc: Jools Holland introduces a special edition of the show starring one of the biggest bands in the world, Fontaines D.C.

programme.title: The Hurt Locker
programme.desc: Following the death of their well-respected Staff Sergeant in Iraq, Sergeant JT Sanborn and Specialist Owen Eldridge find their Explosive Ordnance Disposal unit saddled with a very different team leader. Staff Sergeant William James is an inveterate risk-taker who seems to thrive on war, but there's no denying his gift for defusing bombs.

programme.title: Highland Cops
programme.desc: A knife attack in Inverness leads police to a volatile suspect and a house packed with blades, from Samurai swords to machetes and zombie knives. Released on bail while police await DNA results, he is soon wanted over another violent attack.

programme.title: Question Time
programme.desc: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate from Exeter, with panellists Luke Pollard MP, Ben Spencer MP, Layla Moran MP, Matt Goodwin and Deborah Frances-White.

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: 1982, East Berlin. MI6's Martha Schmitt is paired with the CIA's Kurt Fischer on a disastrous mission. When the Stasi's Friedrich Baumann makes a demand of her, how can she refuse?

programme.title: Honey
programme.desc: After Martha's close brush with the Stasi, she and Kurt investigate a murder, leading them to a sausage factory. Unbeknownst to them, Friedrich's men are also working the case.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Four well-known Radio DJs go head-to-head at one of Britain's biggest antiques fairs to raise money for charity. Hoping to spin loads of profits are BBC Radio 2's OJ Borg and his teammate Melvin Odoom opposite Nikita Kanda and Radio 1's Maia Beth.

programme.title: Blue Planet III
programme.desc: From winter storms to scorching summers, seasonal seas push animals to be resourceful, adaptable, and adventurous. Those who can survive these dynamic seas reap rich rewards.

programme.title: See Hear
programme.desc: An exploration of the history and future of deaf education, from the fight for sign language in schools to the need for better access, representation and support for deaf children.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: Engaging conversation about the political issues that matter to you.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

programme.title: Bridge of Lies
programme.desc: Ross Kemp presents, as four friends, Jacqui, Nigel, Phil and Jane, take on the Bridge of Lies. One by one, they all face the Bridge, choosing who faces each crossing depending on the question category.

programme.title: Coast to Coast Food Festival
programme.desc: Sean Fletcher and Edith Bowman go in search of tips and treats at the York Food Festival, including homemade hummus and the many surprising varieties of the English apple.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo crosses the Culloden Viaduct aboard the Caledonian Sleeper to arrive bright and early in the coastal city of Inverness, from which he heads north on a scenic adventure to the Orkney archipelago. On boggy moorland overlooking the Moray Firth near Inverness, Michael explores the battlefield at Culloden, where Bonnie Prince Charlie's Jacobite army fought British government troops in 1746.

programme.title: Trawlermen: Hunting the Catch
programme.desc: It's the last trip before Christmas and, with demand surging, fish prices are rising. Off the south coast of Cornwall, Ocean Pride is heading out in pursuit of pollock among the old sunken shipwrecks of the English Channel. 380 miles away on the Yorkshire coast, crabber Tydus is preparing to head out with hopes of a big pay day. The aim is to put six tons in the tank, a catch that this week could fetch well over £30,000.
